Wiggle & Snug is a private label brand primarily sold at **Woolworths** in Australia. The "Member+" program you're referring to is likely the **Everyday Extra** subscription offered by Woolworths.

Everyday Extra doesn't provide a specific, reduced price *on the Wiggle & Snug Snug-Fit Overnight Diapers Size 3 itself*. Instead, Everyday Extra members receive:

*   **10% off one shop at Woolworths per month** (up to a certain value).

So, if an Everyday Extra member purchases the Wiggle & Snug Snug-Fit Overnight Diapers Size 3 as part of their monthly 10% off shop, they would effectively pay **10% less than the standard listed price** for that product (and everything else in that shop).

The **standard price** for a pack of 28 Wiggle & Snug Snug-Fit Overnight Diapers Size 3 is typically around **$11.00 - $12.00 AUD**.

Therefore, if a member used their 10% discount on an $11.00 pack, they would effectively pay **$9.90 AUD**.
